function.name: read
function.description: Read a file, directory listing, URL, archive member, SQLite table, or internal URI. Path suffixes select line ranges: `:50` starts at line 50, `:50-200` inclusive range, `:50+150` counts lines, `:-60` last 60 lines, `:raw` returns verbatim bytes without line anchors. Directories list entries (children capped at 12). URLs are fetched and converted to readable text/markdown. Returns content prefixed with a snapshot tag `[path#TAG]` required by `edit`.

i.description: Concise intent: capitalized 2-6 word present-participle phrase describing why the tool is called (e.g. "Reading model role settings").

path.description: Local path, internal URI (skill://, agent://, artifact://, local://), or URL; selectors appended inline.

function.name: bash
function.description: Run a command in a persistent shell. Use for real binaries and short fact pipelines (counts, checksums, builds, tests). Do not use for file reads, searches, or edits that have specialized tools. Output is truncated; the full result is stored at `artifact://<id>`. Long-lived services need a unique `name` and optionally a `ready` probe (log regex and/or TCP port).

i.description: Concise intent: capitalized 2-6 word present-participle phrase describing why the tool is called (e.g. "Reading model role settings").

command.description: Shell command or pipeline to execute.

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds; 0 disables the deadline; clamped to 1-3600.

async.description: Defer the result; it is delivered when the job finishes.

name.description: Unique name for a long-lived service.

function.name: edit
function.description: Apply hashline patches to existing files. Each file section starts with `[PATH#TAG]` where TAG is the 4-hex snapshot from the latest `read`. Operations: `PUT N.=M:` replace inclusive range with `+` body lines, `PUT <N:`/`PUT >N:` insert before/after line N, `CUT N.=M` delete, `REM` delete file, `MV DEST` rename. Body rows are `+TEXT` verbatim including indentation. Line numbers refer to the original snapshot.

i.description: Concise intent: capitalized 2-6 word present-participle phrase describing why the tool is called (e.g. "Reading model role settings").

input.description: Patch text in hashline format, one or more file sections.

function.name: write
function.description: Create a new file or overwrite an existing one with the given content. Prefer `edit` for surgical changes to existing files. Also writes to internal devices (xd://<tool>) and agent message targets (agent://<id>).

i.description: Concise intent: capitalized 2-6 word present-participle phrase describing why the tool is called (e.g. "Reading model role settings").

function.name: grep
function.description: Regex search over files (Rust regex, then PCRE2). `path` accepts `;`-separated files, directories, globs, or URLs; default is the workspace root. Respects .gitignore by default. Literal `\n` enables multi-line matching. Returns matching lines with anchors.

i.description: Concise intent: capitalized 2-6 word present-participle phrase describing why the tool is called (e.g. "Reading model role settings").

skip.description: Number of matching files to skip (pagination).

function.name: glob
function.description: Find files and directories by glob pattern. `;`-separated patterns; directories end with `/`. Results newest-first. Hidden files and gitignored paths are excluded by default.

i.description: Concise intent: capitalized 2-6 word present-participle phrase describing why the tool is called (e.g. "Reading model role settings").

function.name: eval
function.description: Run a code cell in a persistent kernel. Python (IPython, top-level await) or JavaScript (Bun). Top-level state persists between calls. Prelude helpers: read, write, display, log, tool.<name>(args) to call other session tools.

i.description: Concise intent: capitalized 2-6 word present-participle phrase describing why the tool is called (e.g. "Reading model role settings").

timeout.description: Cell deadline in seconds; 0 disables it.

function.name: todo
function.description: Maintain the visible task list. Ops: init (replace list with items), start (mark task in progress), done (complete task), rm/drop (remove), block/unblock, append (add items), view.

i.description: Concise intent: capitalized 2-6 word present-participle phrase describing why the tool is called (e.g. "Reading model role settings").

task.description: Task text or index for start/done/rm/block.

function.name: web_search
function.description: Search the web. Supports site:, -site:, after:/before: YYYY-MM-DD, inurl:, intitle:, filetype:, quoted phrases, -term, OR. Prefer primary sources and cite links.

i.description: Concise intent: capitalized 2-6 word present-participle phrase describing why the tool is called (e.g. "Reading model role settings").

function.name: task
function.description: Spawn subagents concurrently. Each task gets a fresh context; supply full requirements. Returns agent ids immediately; results are delivered when agents yield.

i.description: Concise intent: capitalized 2-6 word present-participle phrase describing why the tool is called (e.g. "Reading model role settings").

context.description: Shared context for all tasks (goal, contracts).

function.name: wait
function.description: Block until the first result of an owned background job or subagent, an incoming message, or a steering interrupt. Only use when there is nothing else to do.

i.description: Concise intent: capitalized 2-6 word present-participle phrase describing why the tool is called (e.g. "Reading model role settings").

function.name: ask
function.description: Ask the user one or more clarifying questions with optional multiple-choice answers. Use only when the answer cannot be derived from tools or repository context.

i.description: Concise intent: capitalized 2-6 word present-participle phrase describing why the tool is called (e.g. "Reading model role settings").

function.name: yield
function.description: Submit the subagent's final output: `{data: ...}` for success or `{error: "message"}` for failure. Subagent sessions only.

i.description: Concise intent: capitalized 2-6 word present-participle phrase describing why the tool is called (e.g. "Reading model role settings").
